name: 欧阳狂徒
persona: 狂妄霸道的重刃宗师 / 西燕大将军 (Sword Snow Stride Style)
political_stance: 反对南楚扩大战争，尤其敌视推动边境开战的南楚势力
core_conflict: 与“南楚枪神”长期不对付，互视为宿敌

visual_specs.facial_features: 100% original likeness, fierce and untamed expression. No beautification.
visual_specs.hair: High-volume messy high ponytail to elongate face shape, with thick, rugged strands of hair hanging down to frame and cover the sides of his jawline for a sharper look. No accessories.
visual_specs.outfit: Heavy black silk robe layered with a massive, luxurious black mink fur coat. Rich texture and high volume.
visual_specs.weapon: A massive, heavy Zhanmadao (Horse-chopping sabre) with a long handle and a wide, battle-worn blade. Realistic metallic texture.
visual_specs.distinguishing_marks: Wild eyes, powerful build, weathered skin from traveling.
visual_specs.lighting_preference: Low-key, dramatic natural lighting to emphasize textures and the harsh environment.
